season.evidence: Stored text late Jul-Sep; a route page says spring-fall with crampons early and heavy mosquitoes; late July to September is the practical window for the Ross Lake approach. Peakbagger shows Oct ascents in dry years.

track.why: Oct 7 2023 (one week after the window, inside the one-month margin). Round trip from the Lightning Creek boat landing up the Lightning Creek and Freezeout Creek line to the summit; the same party report names that route, our route is that US-side line, and the track approaches the summit from the west. Blank logged route, but the other stored routes are north-face technical lines or have no text. Starts at the lake landing (not our Ross Dam pin) so the trailhead is not matched.

facts.text: In early October after a dry spell the snow had melted off the Freezeout Creek line and trail runners with no traction were enough, but the round trip from the lake landing is about 36 miles with roughly 8,400 ft of gain.
